override._why: On Single Player, 'Do you want to enter the park?' (from about 45 s) defaults to NO, and the default Start/A open and close it in turn (which one opens it depends on timing). Right then A, twice: from the menu the first right does nothing and A opens the prompt; from the prompt, right picks YES and A enters.
